title: High-to-Low Cable Fly
summary: A cable fly from high pulleys down toward your hips, which biases the lower chest.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.25 for front delts (minor): each working set adds 0.25 of a set to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Set both pulleys high and step forward into a staggered stance.
Sweep your hands down and together in front of your hips.
Open back up slowly to a stretch.

form_cues.cue: Sweep the hands down and together
Keep your chest up and your shoulders back as your hands meet.

mistakes.text: Bending the elbows into a press.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less lower-chest bias, Less isolation, Less stable.
Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Less lower-chest bias, Peak-contraction focus.
